# GO attempt 1 for the b=8 recovery pass (2026-11-15, commit 496b9233): refused by the driver's own preflight, no GPU use

Kevin's GO authorized exactly one launch of `run_e1_b8.sh e1_b8_recovery` on rack 10 tray16 at commit 496b9233. The launch
was made and the driver stopped itself in its own preflight before any GPU, model or profiler process was started. Per the GO
("one launch only; no retry"), nothing was relaunched. A new GO on a new commit is required.

## Root cause

The cleanup-safety correction (f1b66cde/496b9233) deliberately treats any process whose command line or cwd references the
experiment directories as a *lookalike* unless it is a verified registry record or one of its descendants, and treats any
tmux session named `e1*` as an experiment session. The driver itself runs inside such a session and runs its preflight as
`bash preflight_e1_b8.sh 2>&1 | tee <run root>/<pass>/preflight.log`, so its own `tee` carries the run-root path. The
read-only preflights (18:07, 18:25) were run from an ssh shell with no `tee` into the run root and outside tmux, so this
shape was never exercised before the launch. The driver registers its pid only *after* the preflight (by design: nothing
is registered until the preflight has passed), so the `tee` was not an owned descendant either.

## Correction (CPU only; workload, Nsight settings, thresholds, model and the driver untouched)

* **own invocation pipeline**: `checks/e1_pids.py::plan()` and `checks/e1_process_census.sh` exclude from the candidate /
  lookalike classes the processes whose parent is the checking process or one of its ancestors **and** that share the
  checking process's session id (`/proc/<pid>/stat` field 6). A tmux pane shell and an ssh login shell are session leaders,
  so this names exactly `driver → preflight → | tee` (and the census's own `sed`), never other panes of the same tmux
  server and never processes adopted by pid 1 (a `setsid`'d watcher is not ours just because init adopted it; the first
  version of this rule, without the session test, wrongly excluded all children of pid 1 and was caught by the lookalike
  tests). The plan prints the set (`own pipeline [...]`), the census prints it as an INFO line.
* **own tmux session**: the census resolves the tmux session whose pane pid is one of its ancestors and excludes it from
  "experiment tmux sessions alive" (printed as INFO). Other `e1*` sessions are still reported.
* Nothing was added to the ownership model: the registry, identity verification (pid + start time + boot id + uid),
  re-verification before each signal, refusal of own ancestry and stop-and-report on lookalikes are unchanged.
  `run_e1_b8.sh`, `closeout_e1.sh`, `postrun_e1_b8.sh`, `collect_e1_b8.sh`, `preflight_e1_b8.sh` are byte-identical to
  496b9233 (only the two check scripts, the tests, the hash manifest and documents changed).

## Tests (`tests/test_e1_pids_cleanup.py`, 11 tests; `tests/test_e1_capture_window.py`, 10 tests)

* New `test_own_pipeline_sibling_is_not_a_lookalike`: a `tee` child of the test process writing into a marked
  `…/e1_b8_recovery/preflight.log` is in `plan()["own_pipeline"]` and not a lookalike.
* New `test_census_and_plan_pass_from_inside_the_driver_context`: the exact driver shape on the default tmux server
  (session `e1b8-test<pid>`, `bash census 2>&1 | tee <run>/preflight.log`, then `plan`): the own pipeline line names the
  `tee`, the own tmux session is excluded, none of the pipeline pids appears as FOUND or LOOKALIKE, plan rc 0 when no
  unrelated candidate exists on the host (2 with the pids of unrelated ones, which must not be ours).
* `spawn_lookalike` now double-forks the lookalikes with `setsid -f`, so they are no longer children of the test process
  (a direct child is part of the test's own pipeline and is rightly excluded); the test asserts the lookalikes' parent is
  not the test process. The positive test and the Stage 1.5 regression test (quoted `tail -F … run.log` in a shell's
  command line survives) are otherwise unchanged and pass.
* Results on tray14 (`pytest_cleanup_capture_window.txt`): 21 passed; leftover check 0 processes; test shell and ssh
  session alive after every run. The test runner is a neutral-path script (`$S/scratch/run_tests.sh`) so that the ssh
  command line carrying the experiment paths does not itself become a lookalike while the tmux-context test runs.

## Operating lessons recorded

1. Never put the Stage 1 pattern words (`session_runner`, `nsys profile`, `vllm.entrypoints`) or the experiment paths in the
   text of an ssh command that runs a preflight or waits for one: launch and wait through small scripts at neutral paths.
2. The launching shell must exit right after `tmux new -d` (it does in `run_e1_b8.sh`'s documented launch line).
3. Pods' `spec.nodeName` for tray16 is `pod4-gb300-10-tray16-f3`; a field selector without `-f3` returns nothing.
